Z.warn: Zone BE does not permit Major Industrial for a new building, and the City treats large-scale data centres as Major Industrial (no size threshold given, so the tool applies it to every data centre): rezoning needed (register edm_dc_major). The numbers below use BE's own limits, for comparison only.

screen.why: Edmonton BE s. 5.2: mechanical and electrical equipment, transformers and cooling towers "must be screened from view from Abutting Streets and Sites in non-industrial Zones" (register arch_ezbLoad). The plant is screened by default; "leave it seen" is not offered here.

notes: Noise: needs the roof cooling plant in an enclosed plant room. On the roof, even with low-noise chillers and a solid screen, it would give about 77 dBA at 11830 KINGSWAY NW (BE), 14 m away, over the 60 dBA night limit (Bylaw 14600 s. 22(1)). The plant room is the next measure, and the least that passes; its floor comes out of the building (register arch_nz_nswDcNoise).

Generator test (Community Standards Bylaw C14600 s. 19(3), 21(3), daytime, up to 1 h): one set is about (no residential line on this lot) and 85 dB(A) at the nearest non-residential line (3.1 m, limit 85): within the limits (Kohler enclosure sheet G6-154 for KD2000, Sound Level 2, 78 dB(A) at 7 m, maker claim; free field, our arithmetic). Overnight power cut: one set is over the 60 dB(A) non-residential night limit (ss. 20, 22); the bylaw has no generator exemption (s. 24): flagged, not blocked.

Noise: needs a plant room: solid walls, roof RW 47 or better, gaps sealed, louvres of at least 6–27 dB by band (NSW 2021 Table 4-5): −25 dB (arch_nz_nswDcNoise). Without it: about 65–69 dBA (quieter–standard unit rating) at the property line of 8079 CEDRIC MAH ROAD NW (BRH) (no building on record: point of reception at its lot line, our reading), 79 m away; limit 50 dBA at night (Bylaw 14600 s. 20(1)).

loadingNeed.basis: 1 loading space for 4,217 m² of non-residential floor area (Table 7.2). Each 9.0 × 3.0–3.3 m, 4.0 m clear, wholly on site; backing and turning must not interfere with traffic on abutting streets or alleys (s. 5.80 subs. 7.1). Aisle: Vancouver's 6.1 m used as an assumption.

s.src: Air-cooled chillers with free-cooling coils (air cooling): an air-cooled hall needs chilled water at about 13 °C or warmer (NREL for DOE FEMP, Best Practices Guide 2024, s. 5.2.1), and a dry cooler cannot cool water below the outdoor air (rated units leave it 3–11 K above), so chillers carry the full load in summer. Basis unit: Vertiv Liebert AFC FIZ135, 12.14 × 2.36 m, 2.90 m high, 1,489 kW at 35 °C ambient, 27.8 → 18.9 °C fluid, 30% glycol, with oversized free-cooling coils (Vertiv SL-71060 R09/24, "Preliminary data"; manufacturer claim). genLines: 5 generator sets of about 2 MW carry 8.5 MW; with spares, 6. Placed: 0 on the roof, 6 in the yard.
Each about 13.493 × 3.488 m, 4.777 m high; 1.5 m from the building, 2 m between sets (1 m clear all round, CSA C282 6.5.1.1; register arch_csa_c282).

Fuel in each set's sub-base tank: about 5400 L. In the yard: 3 m from the property line and 1.5 m from the building (CSA B139.1.0 Table 2; register arch_csa_b139). On a roof: at most 1,250 L a tank and 2,500 L a supply line (B139.1.1 6.5.3). FM 5-32 (insurer guidance, not law): not on the roof or in a basement.

base.rule: Height is measured from Grade, a geodetic elevation the Development Planner sets by one of three methods (corners of the site, front-yard corners on steep residential lots, or the rear lot line corners for a building facing an alley) or an alternative method (Bylaw 20001 s. 5.70.2, pp. 826–828; 'Grade' p. 1036). Which method applies is not known, so the lot grade shown is not the base (?).

noiseRoom.block: Noise: the cooling plant (roof) would give about 77 dBA (low-noise units: one rating) at the property line of 11830 KINGSWAY NW (BE), 14 m away, even with low-noise chillers (Trane RTAF 280 LN, maker claim) + a 4.9 m solid screen (roof; NSW 2021, −8 dB): over the 60 dBA night limit with the quieter rating (Bylaw 14600 s. 22(1); the plant runs 24 h, so the night limit governs). 202 neighbouring lots are over. No modelled option brings it under. To bring it under: a smaller size (fewer units); the cooling plant in the yard or split, if that moves it further from this lot; liquid cooling inside, …
